notes: Developer Panattoni presents at township meetings. Township Planning Commission approved the final site plan 5-1 on Wednesday Oct 14, 2026 (Planet Detroit); residents say early construction is under way, so stage may move to building once confirmed. Development on 150 of 282 acres; Google pays the township $15.4M. MPSC case U-22058 (DTE application for special contracts with Google LLC; case number from the Attorney General's Aug 3, 2026 reply brief). Panattoni earlier evaluated Detroit's 38-acre Packard Plant site and found it too small. DTE service expected Dec 2027, full load within a year. 'announced' is the DTE letter of support date on the township page.
